rationale: C13 plausibly supplied the child's compact letter template: both open by saying the President has been following with interest the progress of a pending measure, describe its current Senate consideration, and close by urging favorable action. The near-verbatim opening construction is more concrete than mere similarity in subject or function. C04 and C23 are strong contextual alternatives because they concern executive-branch reorganization and congressional action, but their language and progression are less closely matched.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have been following with much interest the progress of Reorganization Plan No. 1 of 1952
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have been following with keen interest the progress of the Defense Production Bill
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive near-verbatim opening frame, with only the intensity adjective and target measure changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I understand that your Committee has nearly completed its consideration of the plan and will soon file a report to the Senate.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: which passed the House last week and is now being debated in the Senate. As matters now stand, I am much concerned about the outcome.
shared_material.explanation: Both immediately locate the pending measure at its current stage of Senate consideration.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I earnestly hope your Committee will take favorable action on the plan and that it will be approved by the Senate.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Therefore, it is my earnest hope that the Senate will reject the numerous special-purpose amendments ... I would also urge strongly that the Senate approve the full range of powers recommended
shared_material.explanation: Both culminate in an earnest appeal for favorable Senate action on the pending measure.
